Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CMD Suchitwa Mission to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Young Professional post is 09 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech, MBA, MSW, or MSc in Environment Science. The qualification should have been acquired after 01 January 2023.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Young Professional position is 32 years. There is no minimum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Young Professional post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 22 vacancies announced for the Young Professional post by CMD Suchitwa Mission.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Application Screening, Criteria-based Screening, Written Test, Group Discussion, Skill Test/Proficiency Test, and an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the Young Professional post is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official CMD Suchitwa Mission website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the contract period for the Young Professional position?
faq.answer: The job type is mentioned as 'Contract'. Specific details regarding the duration of the contract will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and the online application link can be found in the 'Important Links' section of this article. You can also visit the official website of CMD Suchitwa Mission.
